scene.note: The report's functions call one another, and you follow each traceback up to the one function that made the wrong value.

steps.note: Rhona asks for the hours the team spent on one hill.
Each entry of the log is taken apart, and the hours go down through three calls to be added up.
Python stops in the function that adds, where a number meets text.
Going up the File lines leads to where each hours value was made: the one function to mend.
A packing list arrives, kinds of kit with commas and spaces between them.
Python stops where a kind is looked up in the weights, and the error shows the key it could not find.
Going up the File lines leads to where that key was made: the one function to mend.
The weight of the whole pack comes back as one number.
The positions file holds where each team was last heard.
Python stops inside the json module, code that is not yours.
The last File line in your own file shows what was handed to json, and one line further up is where it came from.
What the file holds comes back as a dictionary of teams.
